dev-libs/glib: Fix units for 'gdbus wait --timeout' This is to fix an upstream glib bug https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/issues/1737. Without this, 'gdbus wait --timeout N <service-name>' command only waits for the service for N milliseconds while the commands document clearly says says that the unit of the --timeout option is in seconds. All of CrOS usage of gdbus wait are 'gdbus wait --timeout 15 <service-name>', and waiting for the service only for 15ms is most likely way too short, which may cause unexpected races or failures. This CL will fix such potential issues as well as b/139313156 which is known. The patch file was taken from https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/commit/cf54fc36003ed50055b094a2d389a12621fe2700.diff without any modifications. BUG=b:139313156 TEST=emerge-$BOARD glib, cros deploy, run 'time gdbus wait --timeout 3 --system foo.bar', verify the command returns after waiting for the service for about 3 seconds. Change-Id: Iee43f787404a4c3c9c5f7a395d518488345b0c65 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1751128 Tested-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
